metadata.title: Nonclosure of stationary Yang-Mills connections under weak convergence
metadata.abstract: We construct a sequence of stationary weak Yang-Mills connections on the trivial vector bundle $B^5\times\mathbb{R}^{15}$ with structure group $\operatorname{SO}(15)$ whose weak limit is a nonstationary weak Yang-Mills connection. Motivated by the stationarity question arising in Tian's work on Yang-Mills compactness, our result establishes the failure of weak closure for stationary weak Yang-Mills connections with an isolated singularity. It also provides a Yang-Mills analogue of the phenomenon exhibited by Ding, Li and Li for harmonic maps.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在五维球上平凡秩十五丛及 SO(15) 结构群中，构造驻定弱 Yang–Mills 联络序列，其弱极限仍弱 Yang–Mills 但不驻定。
analysis.breakthrough: 表明带孤立奇点的驻定弱联络类不具所述弱闭性。
analysis.limitations: 不否定更强收敛或额外正则条件下的紧性定理。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露基础联络和能量集中族由作者独立构造，而定理 1.1 中用于抵消曲率能量密度一阶矩的后续直和构造由 AI 生成。
